spans.s:
(ऊ) मृजू r. 2nd cl. (मार्ष्टि) 1st and 10th cls. (मार्जति मार्जयति)
1 To clean, to cleanse.
2 To be clean or pure.
3 To ornament.
4 To sound.
With अप or प्र prefixed,
1 To sweep, to sweep away.
2 To clean.

m. (-जः)
A musical instrument, probably a sort of tabor or drum.
f. (-जा)
1 Cleaning the body, by washing, anointing, &c.
2 Purification, ablution.
E.
मृज to cleanse, to sound, aff. क or अङ्, and टाप् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Clean, cleansed.
E.
मृजा, and अन्वय order.

mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं)
To be cleaned or purified.
E.
मृज to cleanse, क्यप् aff.; also मार्ग्य.
